observed.front: Apr2019 Street View (t_bm, h191; ref 1131-nne-front01, close): blue-grey lap siding, a purple door with a blue-grey walled court to its west, white gutters and downspouts, roof vents. The 2025 rear reads pale, so the present-day palette is a pale cool grey (disclosed, as for Keppler 1113).
observed.rear: Mar2025 (g8Gw, h281; ref 1131-ssw-rear02, ~59 m): long pale row, upper windows, dishes, lower-window tops above a continuous fence; yard doors are production_inference.

study_notes.eave: Wall top 7.805 = frozen flat base 2.505 + 5.3 m from dated photo proportions (production_inference); source height 6 m retained as identity only
study_notes.limits: Fences, vent pipes, post bands, carport-top finish (shared canopy uses the roof material), finish materials, site and decals parked for later levels. No recognition or stage acceptance claim.
